decisions.name: One-line beats that earn their isolation
decisions.audit_reason: Judges whether isolated lines do dramatic work in context -- an effectiveness/craft judgment, not a raw formatting count.

decisions.name: Blank-line and short-paragraph density
decisions.audit_reason: Pure typographic density count of paragraph formatting; explicitly ignores whether breaks are well placed or improve the story.

decisions.name: Revision depth: continuity, economy, and closed setups
decisions.audit_reason: Measures continuity, economy, payoff, and narrative control -- craft properties an editor treats as quality, explicitly excluding surface errors.

decisions.name: Mechanical slip count (spellchecker-catchable surface errors)
decisions.audit_reason: Tallies spellchecker-catchable surface slips only, explicitly making no judgement on whether they help or hurt the story.
